read.en: SpaceX fell 9.0% on Nov 5 to $123.62, trading between $120.42 and $131.87 on heavier volume; there is no 200-day yet (102 sessions). It is below the falling 5-day ($134.4), 10-day ($140.4) and 30-day ($150.2) averages and the 100-day ($144.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 14 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 14 ($156.29), and RSI is 33.
read.zh: SpaceX 11月5日下跌 9.0%，收于 $123.62，盘中区间 $120.42–131.87，成交量放大；上市仅 102 个交易日，尚无 200 日均线。股价位于下行的 5 日（$134.4）、10 日（$140.4）和 30 日均线（$150.2）以及 100 日均线（$144.7）下方。MACD 自 10月14日起位于信号线下方，处于零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月14日起看空（$156.29），RSI 为 33。

read.en: The drop broke all three supports in the last read ($133.1–134.5, $130.2–130.4 and $125.3–126.7), now resistance. Resistance is $125.3–126.7, then $130.2–131.9 (August lows, Nov 5 high) and $133.1–134.5 (5-day). Support is $120–120.4 (Nov 5 low), then $114.5–115.3 (July–August lows and closes) and $104.8 (Aug 3 low, the 52-week low). A close above $126.7 would target $130–132; below $120, $115.
